display.title: Episode 403: The Hidden Treasure (Parshas Vayeira)
display.summary_short: Avraham Avinu's love of kindness in Parshas Vayeira, and the story of Sarah, a girl who shared apples with the poor and found a treasure when her apple tree fell.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on 16 Cheshvan 5750, the week of Parshas Vayeira. Uncle Yossi explains why it matters to know the week's sedra and its lesson. Avraham Avinu was a man of chesed who set up a tent by the road to feed travelers and teach them to thank Hashem. On the hot day after his bris, when no guests came, missing the mitzvah pained him more than the bris itself, so Hashem sent three angels dressed as travelers. As Avraham's children, we can do kindness at home, with siblings and in school. Then come the Hakochainik march and the Shema with a yeshivah student. The story: Sarah, from a poor family, gives her pennies to tzedakah and shares the apples from her backyard tree with hungry neighbors, teaching them the brachah. A storm uproots the tree and she is heartbroken, but her father reminds her that whatever Hashem does is good, and in the hole left by the roots they find a chest of treasure. Uncle Yossi recalls the Rebbe's blessing that 5750 be a year of miracles, everyone gives a coin to the pushka, and the mailbox brings a request for a brachah before a Chumash test.
display.lesson: Be a child of Avraham: look for chances to do kindness and give tzedakah, and trust that whatever Hashem does is for the good.
